slides.heading: len() with Lists
slides.body: len() with Lists is part of Lists and Mutable Sequences. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: len() with Lists
slides.body: len() returns how many items are in a list. It helps programs measure collection size.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: len() is like counting how many books are in your bag.

slides.body: Lists use square brackets, zero-based indexes, and can be changed after creation.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
